Results.ReviewText:
Let me start off with saying I’ve had other kettle grills other than Webers. Each one the paint would come off after several cooks. Grates would rust extremely fast. These were comparably priced and sized to the Weber.

 Now onto the good stuff! Webers grill grates are top notch quality. The ability to open the grates to add charcoal when cooking is a game changer. Kettle top holder feature is essential and could not do without it after using. This feature also makes cooking a lot of fun between searing to moving the cooked items to a cooler spot and tenting for internal temps to be reached.

Compared to my other kettles the temperature is more stable and easier to manage. If you never kettle grilled there’s lots of videos on YouTube that will get you into the groove of things. There’s a learning curve but it’s a-lot of fun progressing. Once you get it you will be cooking for the masses with lots of smiles. Charcoal is king and you will find out why, flavour town!

Very pleased to write this review and hope this encourages more people jump on the Weber kettle craze. There’s a reason it’s been around for years!

Oh almost forgot, get a charcoal chimney. This one product is a must for quick even charcoal lighting. 

As you advance check out Tuffy Stone and really let your taste buds explode with a Weber grill.
Results.Title: For a Kettle it’s pretty much as good as it gets!

Results.ReviewText:
I recently purchased the Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22" and I can confidently say that it has elevated my grilling game to new heights. This grill is a true gem, and I cannot recommend it highly enough for any grilling enthusiast.

First and foremost, the build quality of this grill is outstanding. The materials used are top-notch, ensuring durability and long-lasting performance. The grill is solidly constructed and exudes a sense of sturdiness. The attention to detail in its design is impressive, from the seamless assembly to the smooth operation of its components.

One of the standout features of the Master-Touch Charcoal Grill is its innovative One-Touch cleaning system. This mechanism allows for effortless ash removal, eliminating the need for messy and time-consuming cleanups. It's incredibly convenient and ensures that you spend more time enjoying your delicious food rather than worrying about maintenance.

The cooking experience on this grill is unparalleled. The 22" cooking grate provides ample space to cook for a large gathering of family and friends. The built-in lid thermometer is an excellent addition, ensuring accurate temperature monitoring without the need for guesswork.

Another feature I appreciate is the hinged cooking grate. It makes adding more charcoal during longer cooking sessions a breeze, eliminating the need to lift the entire grate and disrupt the cooking process. Additionally, the built-in lid holder is a thoughtful touch, providing a convenient place to rest the lid when checking or flipping your food.

Finally, the aesthetics of this grill are simply stunning. It boasts a sleek and timeless design that is sure to impress any guest. The variety of colour options allows you to choose one that matches your style and adds a touch of elegance to your outdoor cooking space.
Results.Title: The Ultimate Grilling Experience

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
